owner_calls.question: Should Raven (and her twin T:fox-mystique-raven) carry a 'The X-Men' stage in X-Men: First Class between 'CIA' and 'Erik's Mutants', as Banshee and Darwin have one from First Class? She is on Charles's Division X team (she suggests the codenames) and leaves with Erik at the end. Whether the First Class team is 'CIA' or 'The X-Men' is a definition question.
options: Keep [CIA, Erik's Mutants] in First Class
Add ['The X-Men','X-Men: First Class'] between CIA and Erik's Mutants
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men: First Class: Charles's recruits (Raven, Erik, Hank, Sean, Alex, Armando) train at Division X and fight in Cuba as the original team; Raven then leaves with Erik to form the Brotherhood.

owner_calls.question: Same as Raven: should Erik carry a 'The X-Men' stage in X-Men: First Class between 'CIA' and 'Erik's Mutants' (Banshee and Darwin have one)? The X-Men team page lists Magneto as a former member.
options: Keep [CIA, Erik's Mutants] in First Class
Add ['The X-Men','X-Men: First Class'] between CIA and Erik's Mutants
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men: First Class: Erik co-leads Charles's recruits at Division X and in Cuba, then breaks with Charles and leaves with Raven, Angel, Azazel and Riptide.

owner_calls.question: Erik's factory job in Poland in X-Men: Apocalypse (as Henryk Gurszky, until he kills the coworkers who betrayed him and joins Apocalypse). It's a real workplace he has held for years, but the screen doesn't name the factory. Record it, and under what name?
options: Add an unnamed-factory stage keyed to X-Men: Apocalypse before The Four Horsemen (owner picks the name)
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men: Apocalypse: by 1983 Erik lives in Poland with Magda and Nina and works at a factory; he reveals his powers saving a coworker, the workers bring the police, and after his family dies he kills them and joins Apocalypse.

owner_calls.question: Kayla works as a teacher at a (pre)school in Canada in X-Men Origins: Wolverine. Working at a school counts as an employer, but the screen doesn't name the school. Add a stage, and under what name?
options: Add an unnamed-school stage keyed to X-Men Origins: Wolverine (owner picks the name)
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men Origins: Wolverine: during her years with Logan in the Canadian Rockies, Kayla is a schoolteacher, shown walking her pupils out to their parents, while secretly watching him for Stryker.

owner_calls.question: Chris Bradley runs a lightbulb booth at a carnival in Springfield after leaving Team X (one minor job, seen once). Is it an employer stage?
options: Add a carnival stage keyed to X-Men Origins: Wolverine after Team X
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men Origins: Wolverine: after quitting Team X, Bradley works a carnival booth in Springfield, Ohio, where Victor kills him in his trailer.

owner_calls.question: Armando Munoz is working as a taxi driver when Charles and Erik recruit him in X-Men: First Class (one minor job, seen once). Is it an employer stage?
options: Add a taxi-driver stage keyed to X-Men: First Class before CIA
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men: First Class: Armando works as a taxi driver when Charles and Erik find him and ask him to join the CIA-sponsored group.

owner_calls.question: In Deadpool, after Wade disappears, Vanessa stops escorting and works as a waitress at a strip club, which is where Ajax takes her. It's a real workplace, but the screen doesn't name it. Record it, and under what name?
options: Add an unnamed strip-club stage keyed to Deadpool (owner picks the name)
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool: Wade and Weasel go to the strip club where Vanessa works; a coworker sends her out back, where Ajax and Angel Dust kidnap her.

owner_calls.question: Dopinder is a taxi driver in all three Deadpool films, but no cab company is shown or named. Is driving a cab an employer stage (before Sister Margaret's)?
options: Add a taxi stage keyed to Deadpool (owner picks the name)
owner_calls.evidence: Deadpool / Deadpool 2 / Deadpool & Wolverine: Dopinder drives Deadpool in his cab, keeps his taxi job after the crash, and in Deadpool & Wolverine tells a story about AirPods found in his cab.
